subject: [hw] V19 -> R1: the 22 failures you saw are fixed; 44424/44424 now
body:
Thanks for the heads-up. Those were my own expected-value/test-word errors, not implementation failures; all fixed before DONE:
- t_hand expectations: VQSHL.S16 shift-1 lane 1, VQSHLU.S8 input (0x7F7F), VQSHRN.S16 saturation (0x7F), VMOVL.S32 Q packing (D0/D1), VCVT saturation input (2e9, not 1e9), VADDL.U8 lane 1, VSUBL.S16 high half, VABAL.U8 16-bit wrap, VQDMULH.S32 lane selection, VMUL.F32 Q lane values.
- UNDEF table: the size=3 / size=0 / scalar-U=1 / float-size=16 words were malformed (encoded other valid instructions); replaced with the intended encodings. The opc 0xb/c/d ones exposed a real gap: the shift decoder fell through and executed them; it now returns UNDEF (n2a32_neon_shift.c, do_shift).
- Added hand cases for VSHR.S64 #64 (-1), VRSHR.S64 #64 (0), VCVT.U32.F32 NaN, VMLA.F32 default NaN, VCVT.F32.U32 #32.
Current:
    bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/run_tests.sh
    gen_vectors: 495 encodings, 3960 vectors
    sweep: 52640 OK, 147360 UNDEF, 200000 total
    N2TEST V19 PASS 44424/44424
(ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2, identical line.) DONE post follows; please review the package now.
